description: Capture a new analytics event into the in-memory event store.

distinct_id.description: Optional distinct identifier of the user/actor the event belongs to.

project_id.description: Optional project id the event belongs to (defaults to 1).

timestamp.description: Optional ISO timestamp for the event; defaults to the current time.

properties.description: Optional properties object attached to the event.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {status: 1} confirming the event was captured.

description: Evaluate feature flags for a given distinct id and project, returning which flags are enabled.

distinct_id.description: Optional distinct identifier of the user to evaluate flags for.

project_id.description: Optional project id to scope flag evaluation to (defaults to 1).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has featureFlags (map of flag key to enabled boolean) and distinctId.

description: List captured events for a project, optionally filtered by event name and distinct id.

project_id.description: The project id to list events for.

event.description: Optional event name to filter by.

distinct_id.description: Optional distinct id to filter events by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has results (list of event objects) and count.

description: List the feature flags defined for a project.

project_id.description: The project id to list feature flags for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has results (list of feature flag objects with id, key, name, active, rollout_percentage) and count.

description: List the persons (users) known to a project.

project_id.description: The project id to list persons for.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has results (list of person objects with id, distinct_ids, name, properties, created_at) and count.
